item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Neon City on the Beat

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text.

item.tests: Tests whether the final montage includes an instrumental music bed and visibly synchronizes its shot changes to audible beats.

answer_sheet.Required imagery: Neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections in a city at night.
answer_sheet.Music source and style: Create an original upbeat electronic instrumental bed; the specific tempo and instruments are your call.
answer_sheet.Editing: Cut between the city shots on the music's beat.
answer_sheet.Voice and text: No talking, singing or added text. Incidental signage is fine.

must_haves: One approximately 10-second landscape video is delivered with music embedded, not just separate video and audio files.
The montage visibly includes neon signs, a moving train and wet street reflections in a nighttime city setting.
An upbeat electronic instrumental bed is audible across the montage, with no speech or singing.
At least two distinct shot changes coincide with clearly audible musical beats or accents.
There are no added titles, captions or subtitles.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a city-at-night montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. I've had this nighttime city feeling stuck in my head and would love to see it brought to life. Please show neon signs and a passing train, and somewhere in all of that, this should be 10 seconds long and widescreen, with wet street reflections as well. Cut between those city shots on the beat of the music. I'm excited to see how these pieces come together. There shouldn't be any talking, singing or added text.

dialog.agent: Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.user: No added text or titles, please, though incidental words on the neon signs are fine. There shouldn’t be any talking or singing either—just the original upbeat electronic instrumental. The visual treatment and shot order are entirely your call.
